query: What experimental matrix specifications (furnace geometry, target temperature ranges and heating/cooling profiles, charcoal species, ore/flux analogs, and replicates per condition) will make gate decisions reproducible?

response.query: What experimental matrix specifications (furnace geometry, target temperature ranges and heating/cooling profiles, charcoal species, ore/flux analogs, and replicates per condition) will make gate decisions reproducible?
response.answer: To make gate decisions reproducible, use a cylindrical furnace, target temperatures from 800°C to 1200°C, heating/cooling rates of 5°C/min, charcoal species like graphite, ore/flux analogs of pure silica, and three replicates per condition.

results.title: Academic Highlights
results.content: Low temperature phases of 1T-TaS2 will be investigated in more details to clarify the debate on Mott insulating phases. Page 143. S N Bose National Centre
